summary: Keep II 1 füllen and its existing Detransitive Part. Pass. box. Feminine mʕaramto agrees with ʕulbe and supplies contextual evidence beyond isolated inherited mʕarmo; no new stem or box is needed.

Register bi+ʕulbe mʕaramto as a recompense collocation, not a new numbered verbal sense. /34 repeats the /29 promise, including two tokens in its full verse; it is not independent support. The single supplied /34 occurrence still receives exactly one decision.
The Part. Pass. describes an attributive result state, not an asserted filling event. English in full measure compresses the concrete heaped-container image; preserve the translation.
64/234 is already the inherited Preterit quotation, with a container suffix and bare content lirat, following mlele with a more specific heaping action. No duplicate is added.
How conventional is the heaped-measure recompense collocation beyond this narrative? Its status is a collocation, not a separate filling sense.
A heaped-full measure images abundant otherworldly recompense without changing the filling/result-state meaning.
